subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the three guard assertions are repaired, do maintainers approve these 14 action updates for execution in OpenClaw's token-, secret-, publishing-, release-, and security-scanning workflows?
rationale: The proposed commits resolve to official upstream repositories and no permission broadening is visible, but the protected security label and executable supply-chain boundary require explicit maintainer ownership.

options.title: Approve after focused proof
options.body: Review the official upstream commits and merge after the repaired exact head passes workflow guards and sanity checks.

options.title: Split sensitive action bumps
options.body: Move Codex, app-token, CodeQL, Docker login/build, and publishing-related pins into narrower PRs for separate review.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Keep the existing pins until maintainers have capacity to review the grouped executable dependency change.

recommendation.title: Approve after focused proof
recommendation.body: Review the official upstream commits and merge after the repaired exact head passes workflow guards and sanity checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CI workflow history makes this the strongest available owner for the final automation and supply-chain decision across the broad workflow set.
